hook.name: DexTaxHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for native-ETH pool pairs that charges a configurable ETH tax (capped at 5%) on every swap, forwarding the fee directly to a recipient address in the same transaction. The tax is always taken in currency0 (native ETH), applied in beforeSwap when ETH is the specified currency and in afterSwap otherwise.
